With the Iraqi invasion of Kuwait a great confrontation began. A host of forces around the world were deployed against the Iraqi army.

In 1943, Hitler launches an armored offensive in an effort to regain the upper hand on the Eastern Front. This is the story of the formidable Russian defense that stalls a massive panzer onslaught on the Northern shoulder of the Kursk salient.
The Battle of Kursk comes to a climax at the Russian village of Prokhorovka on July 12, 1943.

In 1950 the world is caught off guard as North Korea launches a massive armored assault into South Korea. This is the story of the American tankers who rush to the aid of the South and the bloody battles they fight up and down the Korean Peninsula.

In 1916 the British debut a new mobile weapon hoping to break the long bloody stalemate on the Western Front. This is the story of the first tanks and how they change the face of the modern battlefield forever.

At the outset of WWII, the Germans pioneer a new form of mobile armored warfare. This is the story of the famed Nazi Blitzkrieg, as thousands of panzers burst through terrain thought impossible to conquer Western Europe in a matter of weeks.
Deception is a device used to confuse an enemy. From decoy tanks and phony radio broadcasts to the spy whose lies led Hitler to his own downfall.
The Desert Fox becomes outfoxed by the Ultra secret.
This episode explores how obtaining top-secret plans for rockets, jets and missiles was the priority for spies on both sides during WWII.
As the future of Europe and the world hung in the balance, an intricate web of lies tied up German army divisions across Europe.
Eastern and Western offensives of the Allied and Soviet armies in their way to Berlin. Operation Market Garden.
